Fig. 7. Estimation of known amounts of LLI, LAMPE and LAMNE; a) and b) Scenario I: 12% (pure) LLI, 23% LAMNE,de, 6% LAMPE,li, c) and d) Scenario II: 21% (pure) LLI, 4% LAMNE,li, 7% LAMPE,de, e) and f) Scenario III: 9% (pure) LLI, 14% LAMNE,de, 11% LAMPE,de.

Fig. 8. Results of degradation diagnostics; ﬁtted cell OCVs (left column) and estimated degradation mode (right column). a) and b): cell LLI25, c) and d): cell LLI50, e) and f): cell LAMNE,li, g) and h): cell LAMNE,de, i) and j): cell LAMPE,li, k) and l): cell LLI þ LAMPE,li.
